_help: Messages shown at the top of the home screen. Each one needs a unique id. 'from' and 'to' are optional dates (YYYY-MM-DD). The person can close it; it won't show again. Example: {"id": "m2-ready", "from": "2026-11-01", "to": "2026-11-30", "text": "¡Ya está el Módulo 2!", "text_en": "Module 2 is ready!"}
